title: Moon-Stone Restoration: War Memory
description: Moon-Stone Restoration unfolds across moon-stone ring where living terrain changes after every objective, pushing a one active Tuatha Titan to prove adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Moon-Stone Restoration: War Memory advances Roots Below the Gate: Avalora reveals that Gate wounds can be healed only if living terrain is treated as ally, witness, and battlefield at once. It directly tests the faction tension: Their memory is power, but it can become vengeance when old wounds refuse to compost.
